plan.notes: Official Guided Pathways term grid, Mt. San Antonio College (www.mtsac.edu/guided-pathways/pathway-results.html). Transcribed verbatim: course codes, titles, units, term placement. The page does not print a catalog year; 2026-2027 is the current academic year at collection (2026-10-02). GE choice slots (e.g., AA/S MATH) modeled as choice slots per El Camino convention. Choice groups: first row has units, (or) rows are alternatives. The page publishes no prerequisite lists; prereq fields are empty.
